Q: Remove underline of links in email signature in Gmail A:

You can remove link underlining in email signatures in Gmail by using a non-Chrome browser to set up the signature, as follows:

  1. Open your email signature in a non-Chrome browser, e.g. Firefox
  2. Copy the signature - select all (Ctrl/Cmd-A), copy (Ctrl/Cmd-C)
  3. Open Gmail - again in a non-Chrome browser (this is important - Chrome's user-agent stylesheet will interfere if you perform this step using Chrome)
  4. Select the Settings (gear) icon > See all settings
  5. Paste the signature into the email signature field
  6. Save

You can now open Gmail in Chrome and compose a new email. The email signature should appear without the underlined links. If it doesn't work the first time (as it did for me), delete the draft, reload Gmail and compose again.

Q: docker push error: denied: requested access to the resource is denied A:

Use the below commands:

docker login
<Enter the user name and password for Docker Hub Repository>

docker tag first-image {docker-hub-username}/{default-repo-folder-name}:first-image

docker push {docker-hub-username}/{default-repo-folder-name}:first-image

E.g., I have public repository, like manjeet86/docker-repo, so commands would be:

docker tag first-image manjeet86/docker-repo:first-image

docker push manjeet86/docker-repo:first-image

Just see : instead of /. That was the trick. It works for me. I do not know if it lets you tag with / as well in place of :, but that may be for some other purpose.

docker image tag, Examples

Q: How to set up Instant format with Jackson serialization/deserialization A:

Possible solution

It is possible to override the pattern by using the <…> JsonMapper.Builder.withConfigOverride(<…>) method.

Draft example program

Program.kt file

// TODO: package <…>

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonFormat
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper
import com.fasterxml.jackson.datatype.jsr310.JavaTimeModule
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.TimeZone

fun main() {
    val inst = Inst(Instant.now())
    val mapper = JsonMapper.builder()
        .addModule(JavaTimeModule())
        .withConfigOverride(
            Instant::class.java,
            { handler ->
                handler.setFormat(
                    JsonFormat.Value.forPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
                        .withTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC"))
                )
            }
        )
        .build()
    println(mapper.writeValueAsString(inst))
}

Program output

{"date":"2026-02-14 22:01:54"}

References

Solution: `LocalDateTime` serialization issue with custom-configured `LocalDateTimeSerializer` · Issue #288 · FasterXML/jackson-modules-java8: Comment

The comment:

cowtowncoder

on Nov 21, 2023

Ok, first of all: thank you for reporting this issue.

Second of all: I would highly recommend NOT constructing (de)serializers directly but letting JavaTimeModule do that; you can still apply pattern overrides with:

mapper.configOverride(LocalDateTime.class)
   .setFormat(JsonFormat.Value.forPattern(""MM/dd/yyyy""))

But be that as it may, the way you do things should also work.

The comment describes effectively the same solution, but using the ObjectMapper class instead of the JsonMapper.Builder class.

Q: ListView.builder (even Expanded) doesn't work in a column A:

The issue is that showModalBottomSheet with isScrollControlled: true provides unbounded height to its child. When you use Expanded inside a Column without bounded constraints, Flutter can't calculate the layout.

Solution

Use mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min on the Column and shrinkWrap: true on the ListView.builder:

Container(                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  padding: EdgeInsets.all(20.0),                                                                                                                                                                                    
  decoration: BoxDecoration(                                                                                                                                                                                        
    color: Colors.white,                                                                                                                                                                                            
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(                                                                                                                                                                                
      topLeft: Radius.circular(20.0),                                                                                                                                                                               
      topRight: Radius.circular(20.0),                                                                                                                                                                              
    ),                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  ),                                                                                                                                                                                                                
  child: Column(                                                                                                                                                                                                    
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,  // Add this                                                                                                                                                                    
    children: [                                                                                                                                                                                                     
      Text(                                                                                                                                                                                                         
        'Add extra info about your food',                                                                                                                                                                           
        textAlign: TextAlign.center,                                                                                                                                                                                
        style: TextStyle(                                                                                                                                                                                           
          fontSize: 30.0,                                                                                                                                                                                           
          color: Color(0xFFFF86E45),                                                                                                                                                                                
        ),                                                                                                                                                                                                          
      ),                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      SizedBox(height: 16),                                                                                                                                                                                         
      ListView.builder(                                                                                                                                                                                             
        itemCount: selectedFoodList.length,                                                                                                                                                                         
        shrinkWrap: true,  // Keep this                                                                                                                                                                             
        physics: NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),  // Add this                                                                                                                                                       
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {                                                                                                                                                                             
          return SubmitFoodRow(                                                                                                                                                                                     
            foodName: selectedFoodList[index],                                                                                                                                                                      
          );                                                                                                                                                                                                        
        },                                                                                                                                                                                                          
      ),                                                                                                                                                                                                            
    ],                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  ),                                                                                                                                                                                                                
)

Key changes:

  1. mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min - Makes the Column only take the space it needs
  2. shrinkWrap: true - Makes ListView size itself to its content
  3. NeverScrollableScrollPhysics() - Disables ListView scrolling (parent handles it)
  4. Remove Expanded - Not needed when using mainAxisSize.min

This works because now the Column sizes itself to its content instead of trying to expand infinitely.

Q: Can I create a getter/setter capable of mutating a value inside of an Actor A:

This Proposal states that it is not possible at the moment.

For example, because we do not allow for function overloading based only on differences in effects, some sort of mechanism like rethrows and an equivalent version for async (such as a "reasync") would be required on subscript(keyPath:)

For the moment I am continuing to get & set inside different functions.

Q: Can you provide and example of utl_raw.convert + utl_raw.cast_to_varchar2? A:

UTL_RAW.CONVERT is a function to convert a raw from one character set to another character set returning the result as a raw.

So, the functions admits 3 parameters:

  • The raw you want to convert
  • The characterset destination
  • The characterset source

UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_VARCHAR2 converts a raw string into a varchar2 data type.

Let's put it into test

My settings: Oracle 11g Database Character Set: UTF-8

SQL> create table test_raw ( c1 raw(256) ) ;

Table created.

SQL>  insert into test_raw select UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW ( '123009988poee' ) from dual ;

1 row created.

SQL> insert into test_raw select UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW ( 'üäöüöä' ) from dual ;

1 row created.

SQL> commit ;

Commit complete.

EFBFBDEFBFBDEFBFBDEFBFBDEFBFBDEFBFBDEFBFBDEFBFBDEFBFBDEFBFBDEFBFBDEFBFBD
